description: Clips Kitty — free, open-source local AI video clipper that turns long streams and raw gameplay recordings into auto-captioned Shorts, Reels, and TikToks.
notes: Clips Studio was renamed to Clips Kitty at v1.1.3; both 'clips-studio' and 'clips-kitty' shims are provided.
Bundled with FFmpeg, Ollama runtime, Whisper, YOLOv8, and TalkNet weights. On first launch, the setup wizard downloads a local LLM (e.g. Gemma) based on your GPU VRAM, or you can connect OpenRouter.
For raw game captures, enable 'Gaming / Reaction' in the Generate bar before processing so framing, game-audio (PANNs), and on-screen banner OCR scoring are active.
App data, downloaded models, and rendered clips are stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Clips Studio and %APPDATA%\clips-studio and persist across Scoop updates.
